text: What should small businesses do first with AI?
Using AI only in chat does not change how the business runs.
Old AI was more like a chatbot.
Now it can complete a workflow for you.
Marketing, customer service, replies, and follow-ups can all be assisted.
AI does the work. People guard the gate.
Pick only one task and prepare the business materials.
Track time saved, fewer missed follow-ups, and whether small tweaks work.
When AI fails, the company information is often not ready.
Do not chase hype first. Save one person half an hour first.
